nodes.label: Next.js Setup
nodes.rationale: Base Next.js project bootstrapped with create-next-app using App Router, dev scripts, and next/font Geist optimization.

nodes.label: SmartInventory
nodes.rationale: AI-powered inventory management platform combining wireframe brutalism design with automated object recognition and portfolio tracking.

nodes.label: Finish Task Workflow
nodes.rationale: Automated git workflow to check repository status, stage changes, commit with feat message, and push to origin master.

nodes.label: Backend Architectural Conventions
nodes.rationale: FastAPI with SQLModel, Session dependency, strict preservation of JSON structures in InventoryGroup.settings and Item.meta_data, and Alembic database migrations.

nodes.label: Brutalism Design System
nodes.rationale: Strict wireframe brutalist UI using thick solid black borders (border-black), sharp corners (rounded-none), uppercase headers/labels, and mono-spaced fonts (font-mono) for high contrast.

nodes.label: Frontend Architectural Conventions
nodes.rationale: Next.js App Router with TypeScript strict mode, SWR authenticated fetching, UploadQueueContext background uploads, and sonner toasts.

nodes.label: Docker Operational Instructions
nodes.rationale: Mandatory sudo for docker compose operations, containerized pytest testing via legacy sudo docker-compose, and alembic migration execution on startup.

nodes.label: Specialized Inventories
nodes.rationale: Specific inventory types GENERAL, NATURE, and PLACES with dedicated schemas and metadata handling.

nodes.label: Dual AI Providers
nodes.rationale: Configurable AI backend enabling OpenAI GPT-4o or Google Gemini for object identification, categorization, and metadata extraction.

nodes.label: Financial Analytics and Multi-Currency
nodes.rationale: Multi-currency portfolio valuation in USD, COP, EUR with locale-aware currency formatting and dynamic Recharts visualization.

nodes.label: Granular Folder Permissions
nodes.rationale: Collection-level access control allowing folder sharing with Viewer or Editor permissions and custom target currencies.

nodes.label: Geolocation and Mapping
nodes.rationale: Mobile GPS coordinate capture during scanning, static map previews, and one-click Google Maps integration.

nodes.label: Specialized Inventory Modes
nodes.rationale: Domain-tailored recognition modes: Nature Mode for plants/trees with medicinal properties, and Places Mode for storefront details.

nodes.label: Project Rules and Governance
nodes.rationale: Repository governance enforcing sudo Docker commands, automated git commit/push on task finish, centralized .env, and in-Docker pytest testing.
